issue_context.title: Ecobee setpoint weirdness since June's ecobee precision change PR
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The Ecobee integration is showing weird setpoint values (in Celsius), specifically: instead of showing 22.5 C as a setting, it's showing 22.2;  and when changing the setting one step higher, HA shows 21.8 instead of 23 C, and so on.

At the same time the ecobee web GUI and the device itself show the proper values (22.5, 23.0 etc)

This seems to have started after this PR got merged: 

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/48697

GUI example:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/652673/125976647-337ad70e-c398-4ed8-90ce-0602f57b0c20.png)


Development console shows that this is not a GUI problem but an integration problem

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/652673/125976735-394037b4-4765-48e2-97bb-adfc4e90bd68.png)





### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2021.7.2

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2021.5

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

ecobee

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/ecobee/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
(integration added via GUI)
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_
comments: It looks like this is causing issues when converting from F back to C, similar to the Homekit issues we experienced. This one _might_ be fixable by conditionally rounding based on the unit system in use.

Thanks @jjlawren  for reopening this. It is indeed still an issue with 2021.8, it's been a while now and I kind of got used to it but it's weird. It would be nice to go back to what we had in 2021.5 and prior

I am on 2021.11 and my setpoints do not match what the ecobee cards show as in previous versions (I thought a fix was implemented). The current temperature reading does not match either but that is less of a problem as it just seems not to be rounded like the one shown by the app and thermostat. It would be nice if this were configurable (match readings or precise readings).

I've had some time to wrap up some testing on a change (#60039) that _should_ get the Ecobee integration and Ecobee thermostat in-sync when displaying Celsius. This sets the thermostat precision to halves when in Celsius mode, and implements a similar halves precision on the temperature sensors.

I am on 2021.11.4 and for the first time in many months the ecobee display in Home Assistant matches what the wall unit says, yay! My setup is in celsius. Not sure if the patch that @bjpetit mentioned is included in the version I am running but something has changed. Other than upgrade from 2021.10.2 I did not change a thing in my setup.
I am having this issue in 2021.12 as well, hopefully this PR will fix it when it gets merged in

I am also still having the issue. While I understand if the current temperature doesn't match - if the code owners opt not to apply the rounding that ecobee does, I don't understand why the set points always differ. No rounding should be necessary there as the set points are set to full or half degree values (22C / 22.5C) and should stay like that.
